subject: Trial pause request & one-off credits while connector work completes
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@orbitalai.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: brief trial pause + credits while integration completes

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the kickoff last week — the team has been chipping away at the connector but we hit an unanticipated blocker when a third-party library we depend on rolled an incompatible upgrade. Our engs estimate ~2–3 weeks to complete the migration and retest. That timeline puts our POC window at risk.

We wanted to ask whether Redwood can: 1) extend the sandbox trial by 30 days and 2) provision an incremental credit buffer (~40k token-equivalent) so our engineers can finish the integration and run full end-to-end tests without the account throttling out.

I've attached a short scrape of integration logs and the failing stack traces (integration_logs.txt).

Happy to hop on a quick call today. Priya (cc) is our engineering lead.

—Alex
Alex Ramos
Head of Platform, OrbitalAI
alex.ramos@orbitalai.com
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: brief trial pause + credits while integration completes

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and for sending the logs.

I reviewed quickly with our solutions team. We can absolutely do a 30-day extension; the incremental credits are typically handled as a one-off approval for POCs with clear eng blockers. To move fast, I'll request provisional approval from my manager and Marissa from CS to sign off on provisioning.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll request a 40k credit buffer for 30 days (provisional) and share the approval note if accepted.
- Can you confirm the primary test vectors (best guess: 10k prompt tokens/day) so I can align the credit sizing?
- Schedule a 30-min engineering sync (I've proposed a slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orbital-integration-20261116)

If you can reply with a short confirmation of the test size I’ll escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: brief trial pause + credits while integration completes

Ava — I can greenlight the 30-day trial extension for OrbitalAI. For the credit buffer: 40k is within our discretionary POC allowance but I need a short risk note and CS acceptance. Marissa, can you confirm CS/ops will stand up the temporary quota and accept the post-mortem requirement (a short note from the Orbital eng team after the migration)?

Also fee/discounting: this is a pure sandbox credit ask — no price concession. If they convert to paid we will reconcile consumption.

Marking this as high priority. Once Marissa confirms, Ava can notify the customer and ops can provision.

—Ben
Ben Carter

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800

Ben / Ava — I reviewed the logs and the ask. CS approves a one-off 40k token-equivalent sandbox credit for 30 days on the condition Orbital provides a brief post-migration summary (what broke, root cause, and that tests passed).

Operational notes:
- Attachment: approval_note.pdf (internal authorization memo).
- I’ll create the HubSpot case and link to the deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ORB-2026-417.
- Ops: please provision a temporary quota and flag the account for close monitoring; if consumption spikes unexpectedly we’ll step in.

Ava: you can go ahead and confirm with the customer and book the eng sync.

Thanks,
